name: srsRAN O-RAN SC RIC
what_it_is: A containerized implementation of the O-RAN Software Community Near-RT RIC (i-release) that deploys as a multi-container application via a single Docker Compose command, without requiring Kubernetes or Helm. It ships with example KPM and RC xApps and integrates with srsRAN Project gNB over the E2 interface.
components: e2term — E2 Termination Point, connects to E2 agents over SCTP
e2mgr — E2 Manager, maintains E2 node connections and state
submgr — Subscription Manager, handles E2 subscription lifecycle via REST API
appmgr — Application Manager, handles xApp deployment and lifecycle
rtmgr_sim — Routing Manager Simulator using static routing tables (replaces real Routing Manager)
dbaas — Redis-backed Shared Data Layer (SDL) database
python_xapp_runner — Container with Python xApp framework hosting example KPM and RC xApps
protocols: E2AP — E2 Application Protocol for RIC-to-agent messaging
E2SM-KPM — E2 Service Model for Key Performance Metrics (Report Styles 1–5, UE-level and node-level)
E2SM-RC — E2 Service Model for Radio Control (PRB quota management, handover control)
E2SM-CCC — E2 Service Model for Common Configuration Control (O-RRMPolicyRatio)
RMR — RIC Message Router, peer-to-peer internal messaging bus
SCTP — Transport layer for E2 connections
ZMQ — Simulated RF link between srsRAN gNB and srsRAN-4G UE
measurement: E2SM-KPM Report Styles 1–5 covering E2-node-level and UE-level granularity
Subscription-based periodic reporting triggered by xApp KPM subscriptions
configuration: ric/configs/routes.rtg — static RMR routing table shared by all services
.env file — version pins for all service images (DBAAS_VER, E2TERM_VER, E2MGR_VER, SUBMGR_VER, APPMGR_VER, SC_RIC_VERSION)
e2-agents/srsRAN directory — E2 agent configuration for srsRAN gNB
docker-compose.yml — port 36421/sctp for e2term is commented out by default; uncomment to accept external gNB connections
modes: Monitoring mode — KPM xApp subscribes to periodic E2SM-KPM reports and prints UE/node metrics
Control mode — RC xApp sends E2SM-RC control messages to adjust PRB quotas or trigger handovers
Policy configuration mode — E2SM-CCC xApp configures O-RRMPolicyRatio on the E2 node
Local simulation mode — srsRAN gNB + srsRAN-4G UE connected over ZMQ within Docker network
Remote E2 agent mode — e2term SCTP port 36421 exposed to accept connections from external gNBs
constraints: Static routing only — rtmgr_sim uses a fixed routes.rtg file; dynamic routing requires a real Routing Manager with Kubernetes/Helm
Multi-xApp isolation relies on Subscription ID filtering, not true RMR routing isolation
RIC enforces a 60-second time-to-wait timer before accepting E2 agent reconnection attempts after disconnection
xApp may need manual restart to correctly receive RIC_INDICATION messages after initial connection
Locked to O-RAN SC i-release; no upgrade path to later releases provided
No security or authentication mechanisms are implemented in the Docker Compose deployment
E2AP packet inspection in Wireshark requires version 4.0.7 or later
notable_absences: No Kubernetes or Helm support — intentionally simplified to Docker Compose only
No dynamic routing manager — replaced by a static-table simulator
No fault injection or chaos testing tooling
No authentication, TLS, or access control in the deployment
No O1 interface or SMO integration
No A1 interface or policy management framework
No performance benchmarking or load-testing tooling included
No upgrade path between O-RAN SC releases documented
